note: Input data is copied into global static_data[32768] buffer; size may equal 32768 filling the entire array
Lexer end pointer is set to static_data + size (one past last valid byte); when size==32768 this points past the array
lex_config dispatches to lex_string when chr is a string character like 'a'
lex_string loops calling next() consuming string characters until end of buffer
When pos >= end, next() sets pos to end+1 and returns '\0', signaling end of input
After loop exits (isstring('\0') is false), backup is called without checking if pos was advanced past end by next()
backup decrements pos from end+1 to end, then dereferences *pos which reads static_data[32768] -- 1 byte past the global array
